title: ticketing portal processes restarting repeatedly on ord-api-prod-01
description: The ticketing portal service on ord-api-prod-01 has restarted several times in the last 25 hours. Memory usage climbs steadily until the process is killed by the out-of-memory handler. About 25 users reported slow screens or dropped sessions. Users at Hyderabad saw slow responses before each restart.
resolution_notes: Root cause: A memory leak in the caching layer of the latest ticketing portal build exhausted the heap. Rolled back to the previous build and raised a defect for the leak. The fix is scheduled for the next release.

title: Uneven traffic on load balancer, inv-svc-prod-03 saturated
description: Traffic is not spread evenly across the pool and inv-svc-prod-03 is at 35% above its normal load. Response times for the payment gateway are rising. resolution_notes: Root cause: The health check returned 200 on a degraded node, so the balancer kept routing to it. Updated the health check to test the downstream dependency and drained inv-svc-prod-03 for repair.
